test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom from the following options that can substitute the underlined part of the given sentence.

He is the most successful businessman. One of his traits is to __take risk__.
solution:
The correct answer is **Throw caution to the wind​.**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**** **Let's see the meaning of the idiom with an example:

__
 
• Throw caution to the wind​ means to abandon one's cautiousness in order to take a risk.

 
 
• ** ​*Eg.* **She just woke up one morning and said "why don't we** *****throw caution to the wind** *and start a Spanish publishing company for kids?" 
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

Let's see the meaning of the other given idioms with the help of some examples:

 
• **TALK THROUGH HIS HAT **means to say foolish things; to talk nonsense.

 
 
• *** Eg***. Pay no attention to Mary. She is just* talking through her hat.*
 
 
 
• **FILL SOMEBODY'S SHOES** means to replace the person in some role.
 
 
• *** Eg.*** You do so much for the company that I don't see how anyone could *fill your shoes.* 
 
 
 
• **TIGHTEN HIS BELT** means to use less of something; to manage to spend less money.
 
 
• *** Eg. ***Living on my own during college taught me how to* tighten my belt* and get by on not very much.
